Definition: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
BiblicalUsage: 1) to do, fashion, accomplish, make; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to do, work, make, produce; 1a1a) to do; 1a1b) to work; 1a1c) to deal (with); 1a1d) to act, act with effect, effect; 1a2) to make; 1a2a) to make; 1a2b) to produce; 1a2c) to prepare; 1a2d) to make (an offering); 1a2e) to attend to, put in order; 1a2f) to observe, celebrate; 1a2g) to acquire (property); 1a2h) to appoint, ordain, institute; 1a2i) to bring about; 1a2j) to use; 1a2k) to spend, pass; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be done; 1b2) to be made; 1b3) to be produced; 1b4) to be offered; 1b5) to be observed; 1b6) to be used; 1c) (Pual) to be made; 2) (Piel) to press, squeeze
